Package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.event

Class VoiceStateChangedEvent

java.lang.Object
net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.Event
net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.event.VoiceStateChangedEvent
public class VoiceStateChangedEvent extends net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.Event
A player turned their microphone off/on or deafened/undeafened themselves on their client. Posted on the server thread.
